constraints.name: element_value_range
constraints.description: Initial and modified array elements must lie within [L, R].
constraints.formal: ∀ array i, ∀ position j, a_{i,j} ∈ [L, R] before and after changes

constraints.name: per_move_single_change
constraints.description: In one move, at most one element across all arrays can be changed.

constraints.name: final_sums_equal
constraints.description: After operations, the sum of elements in each array must be equal.
constraints.formal: ∃ S such that ∀ array i, ∑_{j} a'_{i,j} = S
